violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED BURGER PATTIES AT 120-128F AND CHICKEN TENDERS AT 120F IN THE SECOND SERVICE LINE HOTBOX, MASHED POTATOES AT 120-123F IN THE SECOND LUNCH LINE, AND BURGER PATTIES AT 120F AND MASHED POTATOES AT 105-107F IN THE THIRD SERVICE LINE HOTBOX.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC REHEATED FOODS TO 165F AND PROPER HOT HOLDING TEMPERATURES WERE DISCUSSED. PLEASE ENSURE HOT HOLDING CABINETS ARE MAINTAINED AT HIGH ENOUGH TEMPERATURES TO ENSURE FOODS CAN BE KEPT AT 135F OR ABOVE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED SLICED CHEESE AT47F, YOGURT CUPS AT 47F, AND SHREDDED LETTUCE AT 44-48F IN THE 2-DOOR UPR AT SERVICE LINE 2.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC MOVED FOOD ITEMS DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS FOOD ITEMS SHOULD NOT BE KEPT HERE UNTIL THE UNIT CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F. PLEASE ENSURE FOOD ITEMS ARE ALWAYS KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED TWO-DOOR UPR COOLER AT SECOND SERVICE LINE AT 50-52F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC CALLED MAINTENANCE AND A TECHNICIAN CAME DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE THE COOLER IS NOT USED FOR TCS FOODS UNTIL IT CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F.
